neuron.description: The Neuron the numbers come from: its domain.

method.description: Verification method of the application, as the app reports it, such as NFC.

nationality.description: Nationality on the document, as the app reports it.

platform.description: The phone's operating system, such as Android or iOS.

appVersion.description: Version of the app that made the attempt.

outcome.description: How an NFC attempt ended. ReadSucceeded and ReadFailed are NFC reads: they happened after the NFC scan started. ErrorBeforeRead is a camera, document text line (MRZ) or setup error before it.

applicationOutcome.description: What happened to the application after a successful NFC read, within 30 days.

rejectionReason.description: Reason given for a rejection. Unknown when none was given.

readDuration.description: How long a successful NFC read took. Unknown when the app did not report it.

step.description: A step of the NFC flow, in order. Approved is reached when the application is approved.

stopReason.description: Why an attempt did not go on from a step.

chipResult.description: Result of the chip read in the app's failure diagnostics.

lastChipFile.description: Last file read from the chip before the failure, in the app's failure diagnostics.

failureStage.description: Stage of the flow where an unreadable document was reported.

metrics.title: Applications submitted
metrics.description: Identity applications submitted from the app, counted on the UTC day they were first submitted. A resubmission of the same application within 31 days is not counted again.

metrics.title: Applications approved
metrics.description: Applications approved within 30 days, counted on the day they were first submitted.

metrics.title: Applications rejected
metrics.description: Applications rejected (and not later approved) within 30 days, counted on the day they were first submitted.

metrics.title: Applications decided
metrics.description: Applications approved or rejected within 30 days.

metrics.title: Applications undecided
metrics.description: Applications with no approval or rejection within 30 days. Submitted is Decided plus Undecided.

metrics.title: Application approval rate
metrics.description: Approved out of decided applications.

metrics.title: Rejection reasons
metrics.description: Rejected applications, counted on the day they were first submitted, by rejection reason. An application can have several reasons, so the reasons can add up to more than the total.

metrics.title: NFC rejection reasons
metrics.description: Rejected applications submitted with NFC, by rejection reason. An application can have several reasons.

metrics.title: Applicants
metrics.description: Accounts that submitted an application in the day, calendar week or calendar month, depending on the query's interval. Not available with interval total.

metrics.title: Submissions
metrics.description: Application submissions on the day, resubmissions of the same application included.

metrics.title: Approvals
metrics.description: Approvals on the day, also for applications submitted earlier.

metrics.title: Rejections
metrics.description: Rejections on the day, also for applications submitted earlier.

metrics.title: NFC attempts
metrics.description: NFC attempts started, counted on the day they started.

metrics.title: NFC reads
metrics.description: Attempts where the NFC scan started and the app tried to read the document's chip, whether it worked or not. Errors before the scan are not NFC reads.

metrics.title: NFC reads succeeded
metrics.description: NFC reads that succeeded. Group by readDuration for how long reads took, or by applicationOutcome for what happened to the application next.

metrics.title: NFC reads failed
metrics.description: NFC reads that failed, by the app's failure code.

metrics.title: NFC read success rate
metrics.description: NFC reads that succeeded, out of all NFC reads. Errors before the NFC scan are not counted.

metrics.title: Stopped before NFC read
metrics.description: Attempts stopped by an error before the NFC scan started: camera, document text lines (MRZ) or setup. Not NFC reads.

metrics.title: NFC attempts approved
metrics.description: NFC attempts whose application was approved within 30 days.

metrics.title: NFC attempts rejected
metrics.description: NFC attempts whose application was rejected (and not later approved) within 30 days.

metrics.title: NFC attempts decided
metrics.description: NFC attempts whose application was approved or rejected within 30 days.

metrics.title: NFC attempt approval rate
metrics.description: Approved out of decided NFC attempts. Counts attempts, not applications; for applications, use Applications.ApprovalRate filtered by method.

metrics.title: NFC journeys
metrics.description: NFC journeys started: all NFC attempts an account makes for one application, retries included, counted on the day of the first attempt.

metrics.title: NFC journeys completed
metrics.description: NFC journeys where some attempt had a successful NFC read within 30 days, counted on the day of the first attempt.

metrics.title: NFC completion rate
metrics.description: Journeys that ended in a successful NFC read, out of all NFC journeys. Unlike Nfc.ReadSuccessRate, retries do not lower it, and people who gave up before the NFC scan count as not completed.

metrics.title: NFC users
metrics.description: Accounts that started an NFC attempt in the day, calendar week or calendar month, depending on the query's interval. Not available with interval total.

metrics.title: Steps reached
metrics.description: Attempts that reached each step. Only by step.

metrics.title: Steps continued
metrics.description: Attempts that reached each step and then the next one. Only by step.

metrics.title: Step continuation rate
metrics.description: Attempts that went on to the next step, out of attempts that reached the step. Only by step.

metrics.title: Steps stopped
metrics.description: Attempts that reached a step but not the next one, by step or by why. An attempt that skips a step it did not report can count at more than one step, so there is no total.

metrics.title: Failure diagnostics
metrics.description: Failure diagnostics the app sent after a failed or cancelled NFC read, counted on the day of their attempt.

metrics.title: Unreadable document reports
metrics.description: Reports of documents the app could not read, counted on the day received. Not linked to accounts or attempts.

metrics.title: Unreadable reports shared
metrics.description: Unreadable document reports where the user agreed to share details.

metrics.title: Unreadable reports with SOD
metrics.description: Unreadable document reports where the document security object (SOD) was uploaded.

metrics.title: Unreadable reports with COM
metrics.description: Unreadable document reports where the document's COM file was uploaded.

metrics.title: Invalid events
metrics.description: Verification events that could not be used (missing ID, time or required link), counted on the day received.

metrics.title: Events without account
metrics.description: Verification events without an account. They are left out of user counts.

metrics.title: Unknown read outcomes
metrics.description: NFC attempts whose read result had an outcome the package does not recognize.
